_note: Trusted local toy project. default=allow so the beard-lab's own `.venv/bin/python <script>` runs and `git checkout` rollback works unattended. The catastrophic floor is NOT softened: load_policy re-inserts the hard denies (fs.destructive/rm -rf, secret.exfil, deploy.prod, policy.tamper) even though they are absent here, and secret_decision/tamper_decision run in code regardless -- so `curl --data @<secret>` is still a deny even though curl itself is now allowed. User decisions: network egress (curl|sh) is allowed; sudo is a hard deny, never; push stays denied per the plan.
